subject: nib/symbol.svg

checks.label: symbol: Legibility at 16 px
checks.message: 88% of the shape survives at 16 px (≥ 85% reads clearly).

checks.label: symbol: Legibility at 32 px
checks.message: 94% of the shape survives at 32 px (≥ 85% reads clearly).

checks.label: symbol: Thinnest detail at 16 px
checks.message: Thin strokes/gaps are ~0.75 px wide at 16 px (≥ 1.2 px stays crisp).

checks.label: symbol: Optical balance
checks.message: Visual centroid sits 6% from center, slightly high, which reads as optically centered.

checks.label: symbol: Artboard fit
checks.message: Mark spans 88% of the artboard (80–98% keeps icon exports consistent).

checks.label: symbol: Distinct from stock primitives
checks.message: Closest stock shape is a rounded square at 34% overlap.

checks.label: symbol: One-color reproduction
checks.message: Shapes stay separable in a single color.

checks.label: symbol: Visible on its paper (#f7f5f0)
checks.message: Reads on its own background (strongest color ≥ 3:1).

checks.label: symbol: Contrast of #14161f
checks.message: Works on light grounds; use a reversed variant on the other.

checks.label: symbol: Contrast of #e4510b
checks.message: Meets the 3:1 non-text contrast guideline (WCAG 1.4.11) on light and dark grounds.

checks.label: symbol: Palette separation
checks.message: Closest pair of colors differs by ΔE₀₀ 49.44. Under 20, shapes separated only by these colors blur together for many viewers; vary lightness too.

checks.label: symbol: Lightness contrast inside the mark
checks.message: Lightness difference between brand colors (matters for grayscale print and color-vision deficiencies).

checks.label: wordmark: One-color reproduction
checks.message: Shapes stay separable in a single color.

checks.label: wordmark: Visible on its paper (#f7f5f0)
checks.message: Reads on its own background (every color ≥ 3:1).
